svg.title: Fork vs upstream CodeGraph: every result
svg.desc: Heatmap of the fork's change against upstream for full index time, peak memory and one-file sync on seven repositories, the MCP server on n8n and gin, and command-line startup. Of 74 comparisons it is better in 65, about the same in 4 and worse in 5.
svg.text: Each cell is the fork’s change versus upstream. Negative is better (less time or memory). Green = better by over 3%, amber = about the same, red = worse.
Grey n/a: the one-file sync exited with an error for upstream on Node and upstream on Bun, so there is no time to compare.
Measured 2026-10-18 · upstream 986de95c vs fork 633fc82c · Node 24.22.0, Bun 1.4.3 · 16-vCPU WSL2 · two runs per arm, median · fork on Node unless noted
